bib.title: Momentum Contrast for Unsupervised Visual Representation Learning
bib.venue: preprint (arXiv v3, 23 Mar 2020; CVPR 2020 not printed in text)

question: Can a large and consistent dictionary for contrastive learning, built with a queue and a momentum-averaged key encoder, give unsupervised visual representations that match or beat ImageNet supervised pre-training when transferred?
hypothesis: Good features can be learned by a large dictionary covering many negatives, while the key encoder is kept as consistent as possible despite its evolution.
contributions: MoCo: dictionary as a queue plus momentum-updated key encoder, decoupling dictionary size from mini-batch size
Shuffling BN to stop intra-batch statistics leaking the positive key
Competitive ImageNet linear classification and transfer that beats ImageNet supervised pre-training on 7 detection/segmentation tasks, including at Instagram-1B scale

method.summary: Instance-discrimination pretext task with InfoNCE loss; query encoder trained by SGD, key encoder updated as a moving average of the query encoder, keys held in a queue of K entries. Evaluated by ImageNet linear classification on frozen features and by fine-tuning on detection/segmentation tasks against ImageNet supervised pre-training.
method.task: unsupervised visual representation learning (contrastive, instance discrimination)

datasets.name: ImageNet-1M (IN-1M)
datasets.split: train set for pre-training; val set for linear classification
datasets.preprocessing: 224x224 crop from randomly resized image, random color jitter, horizontal flip, random grayscale

datasets.name: Instagram-1B (IG-1B)
datasets.source: ~1500 hashtags related to ImageNet categories, following [44]; uncurated, long-tailed

datasets.name: PASCAL VOC trainval07+12 / trainval2007 / test2007
datasets.split: fine-tune on trainval, eval on test2007

datasets.name: LVIS v0.5, Cityscapes, VOC semantic seg (train_aug2012), iNaturalist 2018
datasets.size: Cityscapes fine 2975 train images; VOC aug 10582 images; iNat ~437k images, 8142 classes

other.shuffle_bn: key encoder batch shuffled across GPUs

training.objective: InfoNCE (Eqn 1), tau=0.07, one positive and K negatives from queue; positives are two random augmented views of same image
training.lr_schedule: IN-1M: x0.1 at epochs 120 and 160; IG-1B: exponentially decayed by 0.9x every 62.5k iterations (64M images)
training.batch_size: IN-1M: 256 on 8 GPUs; IG-1B: 1024 on 64 GPUs
training.hardware: IN-1M: 8 GPUs (8 Volta 32GB mentioned as high-end machine); IG-1B: 64 GPUs
training.compute: IN-1M ResNet-50 ~53 hours; IG-1B ResNet-50 ~6 days
training.seeds: downstream results averaged over 5 trials; pre-training seeds not stated

other.queue_K: 65536 default for Table 1; 4096 in momentum ablation
other.linear_classifier: 100 epochs, grid-searched lr 30, weight decay 0, on global-average-pool features
other.detection_finetune: BN tuned (synchronised across GPUs), BN also in FPN; same hyperparameters as supervised counterpart; VOC 24k iterations (~23 epochs), image scale [480,800] train / 800 test; COCO scale [640,800]/800, 1x (~12 epochs) or 2x schedules, 6x (~72 epochs) in appendix

metrics.name: ImageNet linear top-1 accuracy
metrics.definition: unsupervised pre-train on IN-1M, freeze, train linear classifier, 1-crop top-1 on val

metrics.name: AP50 / AP / AP75
metrics.definition: detection AP at IoU 50% (VOC default), COCO-style AP, and IoU 75%; APbb box, APmk mask

baselines: ImageNet supervised pre-training (same architecture and schedule)
end-to-end and memory bank contrastive mechanisms (own implementations)
Exemplar, RelPos, Jigsaw, Rotation, Colorization, DeepCluster, BigBiGAN, InstDisc, LocalAgg, CPC v1/v2, CMC, AMDIM
eval.protocol: Fine-tuning uses the same settings as the supervised counterpart with no extra hyperparameter search; downstream numbers averaged over 5 trials.

availability.data: IG-1B is Facebook-internal following [44]; not stated as released

limits: IG-1B gain over IN-1M is small, suggesting larger data not fully exploited (authors)
Only simple instance discrimination pretext task explored; no linear-probe parity with supervised
Fine-tuning reuses supervised-counterpart hyperparameters; VOC semantic segmentation is a negative case, iNaturalist comparable only
Pre-training seeds and warmup not stated; IG-1B not public
Linear protocol requires lr 30, implying feature magnitudes differ from supervised features, so BN is tuned in fine-tuning
Linear accuracy later superseded by MoCo v2 (71.1%)

shuffle the key mini-batch order across GPUs before the key encoder then shuffle back, so query and positive key use BN statistics from different subsets
